title: bulbocapnos lobellii
intro: Bulbocapnos lobellii, commonly known as Lobelia, is a plant species in the family Papaveraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, specifically lobeline and lobelanine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
